Q1: How should the fix handle the `.claude/settings.json` parity part of this issue?
Choices:
A) Fix only `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`: add the 5 missing env keys to the standalone sweep step, using the same expressions as the full poller step. Leave `.claude/settings.json` untouched. PR CI already tolerates that drift, `sync-claude-live-copies.yml` copies the live file once the template reaches `main`, and pipeline editors cannot write `.claude/**`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Same as A, and also record an operator step to copy `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json` byte-for-byte over `.claude/settings.json` on `orchestrator/project-6664`.
C) Remove the `prepush_affected_tests.py` hook entry from `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json` so the two copies match without editing the live file. **Note:** this undoes the #7137 hook registration.
